item.title: London
item.description: Food Homeslice for pizza (try the pomegranate tahini cauliflower chickpea pizza) Inamo - Japanese food The Kati Roll Company Dishoom - overrated but worth trying once Nandos - gotta go once at least DUM Biryani House Crosstown Doughnuts Roti Chai - Indian street food Tibits and Soho vegan market (all veg/vegan menus, vegan options widely available) Hoppers - Amazing Sri Lankan food Ping Pong - Japanese Pachamama - Peruvian Places to Go Oxford Street - shopping hub Picadilly Circus Hyde Park Regents Park Tower Bridge Thames River Cruise Walk along the Thames Anchor Shakespeare’s Globe Shard London Eye Borough Market - cool to walk around Camden Market - lots of good food Old Spitalfields - nice shopping and food Brick Lane - Banglatown, less posh with great food (look for Chai Bros) Imperial War Museum Mr.

item.title: NYC → Acadia
item.description: Highlights Cliffs along Ocean Path Trail or drive along the coast with parking lots and scenic stops Highlights: Otter Cliffs and Thunder Hole Sand Beach Nice and cold water, north side of Ocean Path starts here Note: Northmost part of the trail is less exciting Cadillac Mountain Highest peak, hike or drive up Sunrise is beautiful, sometimes the first in the US to see it Permit required during summer to drive up: https://recreation.
